body: Hindi ko ito tatawaging policy trend from one mailing cycle, pero may useful pattern to watch: benefits na technically available pero may claim friction at deadline can create a gap between eligibility and actual receipt. For ALAM, magandang recurring signal ang 'official money + required action + expiry/retroactivity cutoff.' If similar notices keep appearing across pension, childcare or municipal support, that becomes a practical administrative-risk pattern—not glamorous, pero mas useful kaysa limang futuristic headlines bago breakfast.
